purpose: Define Orientation Space O as the admissible space of participation directions governing bar expressions, Org_a preservation, and knot-class selection.

definition.name: Orientation Space
definition.reading: O(G) denotes the admissible orientation structure of a participation graph or grouped bar expression G.
definition.primitive_role: Orientation determines how distinction participates. It is not merely geometric direction, object location, or visual layout.

core_claim.statement: Orientation is a participation constraint on admissible distinction organization.

components.rho: role map declaring participant function such as ordinary participant, mediator, operator, core, residue-carrier, or projection-domain object

formal_candidate.orientation_space: O(G) := set of admissible orientation assignments over E_| and role-typed participants in G
formal_candidate.admissible_orientation: Adm_O(G,o) := [o preserves typed interface direction, role participation, admissible regrouping constraints, and distinction-evaluable closure]

relationship_to_bar_operator.statement: A|B carries orientation by default. Therefore A|B is not generally equivalent to B|A.
relationship_to_bar_operator.binary_case: O(A|B) records the legal participation direction of the interface.
relationship_to_bar_operator.group_case: O(G) records the legal orientation structure of grouped bar expressions.
relationship_to_bar_operator.reversal_rule: A reversal is legal only if Rev_|(A,B) or a higher grouped orientation equivalence is proven.

relationship_to_grouped_closure.definition_candidate: Preserve_O(G -> G') := ∃o ∈ O(G), ∃o' ∈ O(G') such that G iff_R G' while preserving admissible orientation participation.
relationship_to_grouped_closure.forbidden_move: Do not treat regrouping or permutation as legal unless orientation preservation is demonstrated.

relationship_to_Org_a.statement: Org_a must preserve admissible orientation structure across legal transformations.
relationship_to_Org_a.axiom_dependency: Topological Consistency and Admissibility Conservation require Preserve_O over organized participation fields.
relationship_to_Org_a.candidate_rule: Org_a may act on G only if Adm_|^G(G) and ∃o ∈ O(G) satisfying Adm_O(G,o).

relationship_to_Sigma_D.statement: Sigma_D equivalence must preserve orientation participation class, not merely operand inventory.
relationship_to_Sigma_D.candidate_rule: Sigma_D(G) = Sigma_D(G') only if G and G' preserve admissible distinction inventory, grouped bar closure, and orientation equivalence under iff_R.

relationship_to_OPEN_BRIDGE_001.bridge_hypothesis: Orientation functions as a topological selector constraint on admissible knot-class selection.
relationship_to_OPEN_BRIDGE_001.candidate_bridge_statement: For a participation graph G, admissible orientation assignment o ∈ O(G) restricts the admissible knot class K(G,o).
relationship_to_OPEN_BRIDGE_001.warning: This patch does not close OPEN_BRIDGE_001; it supplies the missing primitive required to attempt closure.

orientation_equivalence.definition_candidate: G ≃_O G' iff there exist admissible orientations o ∈ O(G), o' ∈ O(G') such that their participation directions, typed roles, and closure behavior are preserved under iff_R.

orientation_failure_modes.name: direction_erasure
orientation_failure_modes.description: A|B is treated as equivalent to B|A without reversal proof.

orientation_failure_modes.name: role_erasure
orientation_failure_modes.description: A mediator/core/operator participant is treated as an ordinary participant without typed justification.

orientation_failure_modes.name: group_flattening
orientation_failure_modes.description: A grouped expression is reduced to an unordered list.

orientation_failure_modes.name: projection_import
orientation_failure_modes.description: A domain-specific orientation meaning is imported before a bridge is registered.

orientation_failure_modes.name: topological_overclaim
orientation_failure_modes.description: Orientation is claimed to define K before knot object rules are formally closed.

Move orientation_space_O from GAP_OPEN to GAP_DEFINITION_CANDIDATE
registry_updates_required.condition: Only after registry schema validation passes.

textbook_patch_required.target_section: Chapter 14 Stage 0 subsection or primitive object appendix
must_state: Orientation is a participation constraint, not merely spatial direction.
A|B is order-sensitive because its interface carries orientation.
Grouped bar closure requires orientation preservation.
Org_a must preserve admissible orientation structure.
OPEN_BRIDGE_001 can now be attacked through the hypothesis that orientation selects admissible knot classes.

validation_requirements: No downstream debt object may be marked closed by this patch alone.
Org_a becomes definition-draftable but not automatically closed.
forbidden_claims: A|B and B|A are equivalent by default.
Projection-domain orientation can be imported without bridge validation.

recommended_next_patch.goal: Define Org_a axioms using admissible bar closure, grouped closure, and orientation preservation as explicit prerequisites.
